capabilities: Display a customizable dashboard of writing streaks, heatmaps and word trends
List overdue and upcoming tasks and jump to the task line
Run vault check-ups for broken links, orphans, empty and oversized notes
Generate weekly and monthly Markdown writing reports
Find and clean up duplicate passages across notes
extras: Warns that writing word-count properties rewrites the whole frontmatter block (YAML comments can be lost) and advises backing up first; reads notes locally only and makes no network requests; UI is bilingual (English/Chinese); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dashboard that aggregates writing streaks, word trends, task due dates and vault health into one place.

relations.evidence: This used to be a separate plugin, Clip Dedupe. It is now built into Note Pulse

summary: Vault statistics dashboard showing writing streaks, word and note trends, due tasks, tag and folder stats, vault check-ups, and duplicate cleanup.
